evidence.fact: Mountain Project search listing gives Straight Eight (Bear's Den, Hatcher Pass) as 75 ft trad.
Listing credits first ascent to Jay Rowe and Paul Turecki; no year given.

ak_straight_eight.note: MP search listing rates it 5.9, app has 5.8+; grade not recorded. Route page fetch returned 429; Mountain Project treated as walled for the rest of the chunk.

evidence.fact: Mountain Project listing credits first ascent to Cedar Wright and Renan Ozturk, 2007.
AAJ 2008 report: Wright and Ozturk named StumpJumper after climbing it on their summer 2007 Ruth Gorge trip.

facts.value: Follows the corner right of Brownfinger only loosely, then leaves it for a featured, sparsely protected upper headwall called the Leap of Faith.

evidence.fact: AAJ: line wanders either side of the corner, then leaves it for a high-quality featured face with little protection ("Leap of Faith").

facts.value: Independent line on The Stump with consistently good rock, right of Brownfinger, which lies right of Goldfinger, Ruth Gorge.

evidence.fact: AAJ: line is fully independent on consistently good rock; next corner right of Brownfinger, itself right of Goldfinger.

ak_stumpjumper.note: Grade: AAJ says 5.11R, MP listing 5.11b R; not identical, not recorded. AAJ gives no descent detail for StumpJumper beyond descending in snow.
